content:
It's time for us to take another tour of Apple's Certified Refurbished Store, where we'll take a closer look at what hidden gems are worth paying attention to this time around. We're not talking about Mac computers that have tumbled off the back of a truck in batches, with scratched casings, then flipped on eBay at slashed prices. These are products that have gone through Apple's "strict refurbishment process," come with the same one-year Apple warranty as brand-new units, and are even more affordably priced.

You won't find AirPods Pro 3 hitting an all-time low here, nor will AirTag 2 be marked down to rock bottom; but you'll save several hundred dollars on Mac machines, while currently available models are being offered at the cheapest prices in town. Let's take a look at this week's curated picks right away.

Apple Refurbished Store — This Week's Picks

***Certified Refurbished product inventory is extremely limited, available while supplies last.

Chance — MacBook Pro

This week, I recommend keeping an eye on Apple's M5 MacBook Pro lineup. In the Certified Refurbished Store, this series spans a very wide price range — starting from under US$2,000 and going all the way up to nearly US$9,000 — so no matter your budget, there's always one that suits you. Besides, one of the biggest reasons to pick a MacBook Pro over a MacBook Air is that absolutely gorgeous Liquid Retina XDR display.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro, 1TB storage, 16GB memory: US$1,699 (brand-new original price US$1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro, 2TB storage, 24GB memory: US$2,719 (brand-new original price US$3,199)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro, 2TB storage, 24GB memory: US$2,969 (brand-new original price US$3,499)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro, 1TB storage, 48GB memory: US$3,059 (brand-new original price US$3,599)
  • 14-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro, 8TB storage, 36GB memory: US$6,029 (brand-new original price US$7,099)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro, 8TB storage, 128GB memory: US$8,499 (brand-new original price US$9,999)

Zac — Apple Watch SE 3

Looking to buy a brand-new Apple Watch? What's the lowest price around? The most affordable current-generation Apple Watch in the Certified Refurbished Store is this one: the 40mm Apple Watch SE 3 GPS model, starting from US$209.

The refurbished version is US$30 cheaper than buying the same spec brand-new on Amazon, and a full US$40 cheaper than Apple's official brand-new price. It can also be upgraded to watchOS 27 launching this autumn, making it a truly excellent value choice for users who want to get into an Apple Watch at a low price while still enjoying free software updates.

Justin — Apple Watch Series 11

We've always been quite taken with Apple's refurbished pricing — as Zac mentioned above, the cheapest Apple Watch SE 3 in town really can be found here. However, this isn't always the case, and that's certainly not the situation with the latest Apple Watch Series 11.

Consider this a friendly reminder from 9to5Toys — although the Refurbished Store does carry deals on the Apple Watch Series 11, you can actually pick up a brand-new Series 11 on Amazon right now for an even lower price. The 42mm Series 11 is originally priced at US$339, while the 46mm Series 11 is US$369, but Amazon is currently marking both models down, with up to US$100 off brand-new units

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 starting from US$399 (original price US$429)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 starting from US$329 (original price US$429)

Ryan — MacBook Neo

If you need a new MacBook, the Neo is the model least likely to be replaced in the near term. The MacBook Pro will be getting its M6 refresh later this year, while the MacBook Air is expected to upgrade to M6 in early 2027. However, to date, rumors about the next-generation MacBook Neo remain extremely scarce. If value for money is your top priority, picking up a MacBook Neo for US$599 is an unbeatable deal. Of course, some professional users may need a more powerful machine, but for the vast majority of users, the MacBook Neo is more than capable of handling your everyday needs.

  • MacBook Neo: US$599 (original price US$699)
  • MacBook Neo with Touch ID: US$679 (original price US$799)
